summary: The reconnaissance plan comprehensively addressed the brief: documented all five tables' schemas with complete dtype distributions, verified identifier uniqueness across candidate keys (revealing pharmacy_npi non-join), determined date ranges across all temporal columns with consistency checks, and identified key quality issues (entirely null columns, 36 date ordering inconsistencies, pharmacy provider mismatches). All four required artifacts were produced with proper source citations, enabling downstream analysis teams to understand data structure and constraints.
